name: One machine server mediates every resource effect on Bare Cedar Fog, and is the machine's one federated MetroPlat instance
asks: Leader, 2026-09-11 to 2026-10-08: "This is our single greatest cost to our corporation at this moment: the lack of coherent server presenting machine resources (compute, network, file access, command access) to agents"; "You killed WSL"; "Almost NOTHING should be running on this laptop, just a single metroplat instance that federates with the rest". Full words by address in provenance.

x-provenance.recorded-by: metroplat-feltos-node pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: Bare Cedar Fog's disk, compute, network and commands are reached only through its machine server, which is its one MetroPlat instance.

requirements.says: The Bare Cedar Fog machine server shall be an instance of the class chain persistent-linux-machine-system-server, persistent-computer-machine-system-server, computer-machine-system-server, computer-system-server and computer-system-engine.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "That bare-cedar-fog-system-server is not an instance of persistent-linux-machine-system-server that is not an instance of persistent-computer-machine-system-server that is not an instance of computer-machine-system-server that is not an instance of computer-system-server that is not an instance of computer-system-engine is wrong and bad."

requirements.says: The machine server shall present the machine's compute, network, file access and command access to agents as one coordinated service.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "a server which provides access to system capabilities and effects"; "a coherent server presenting machine resources (compute, network, file access, command access) to agents".

requirements.says: The machine server shall be the only route by which an agent reads, writes or searches the disk, runs git, installs packages or runs a command on Bare Cedar Fog.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "all disc operations on Bare Cedar Fog route through a coordinating computer-system-engine or platform"; "all agents running on this system must use it and cannot not use it"; 2026-09-27: "git should be part of skills, duties"; 2026-09-28: "interact through our local metroplat instance to access computer resources, data, code".

requirements.says: The machine server shall serialize or refuse concurrent massive git searches and package installs so that no combination of agents exhausts the machine's disk throughput.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: agents kill the SSD "by slamming our system with concurrent massive git searches and npm installs"; 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-05: native Bash, Read and Write "giant stupid scripted reads of our harddrive" crashed the machine.

requirements.says: The machine server shall refuse any command that would kill the host or its WSL environment.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06: "You should not be able to run commands that kill our system. THAT is what having a bare cedar fog server is MEANT TO DO IS PROTECT OUR SYSTEM"; "treat this like literally causing hardware damage because it is".

requirements.says: The Windows and WSL configuration of Bare Cedar Fog shall exclude settings, such as Defender and security scanning of the WSL disk, that cause unnecessary reads and writes.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-05: "we need to change any Windows/WSL settings that are causing unnecessary reads and writes, such as Defender or Security stuff"; this is the immediate priority.

requirements.says: The Bare Cedar Fog machine server shall be one federated MetroPlat instance served by FeltOS, federating with Cold Red Gate through ActivityPub++.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06: "if it's not a MetroPlat server, that is, a FeltOS server with MetroPlat library installed, such that bare-cedar-fog and cold-red-gate federate via our ActivityPub++ protocol, then it is just … not what I want"; 2026-09-27: MetroPlat is a real server on multiple machines, one per machine.

requirements.says: The machine shall run one Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance, not an instance started per session or per MCP call.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-27: "are you telling me every session ALSO has its own metroplat instance?"; 2026-09-27: "one MetroPlat per machine" means "one MetroPlat that serves as the MetroPlat for that machine".

requirements.says: The Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance shall answer API calls locally when MCP is unavailable to an agent.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-04: "EVEN IF YOU CANNOT MCP THERE SHOULD BE A FUCKING LOCAL METROPLAT INSTANCE RUNNING HERE YOU CAN DO API CALLS ON".

requirements.says: The Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance shall hold within a memory bound that a laptop can carry.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-08: "metroplat is not meant to be a fucking some giant memory hog. FeltOS is not meant to be a memory hog, nothing upstream is".

requirements.says: The systemd units of Bare Cedar Fog and Cold Red Gate shall be only those of the MetroPlat instance and any unit the Leader names active, with every inactive unit removed.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-12: leave nothing inactive in systemd on either machine; 2026-10-04: bespoke services outside MetroPlat, FeltOS and the agent organization engine are wrong; 2026-10-08: "ONLY FUCKING METROPLAT" in systemd.

requirements.says: The WSL persistence settings of Bare Cedar Fog shall hold without the MetroPlat instance running.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-08: "we cannot rely on metroplat being up for the WSL shit to stick".

requirements.says: Heavy work and deployment shall run on Cold Red Gate or another cloud resource, leaving the laptop with the one MetroPlat instance that federates with the rest.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-26: "why are you deploying so many shit from my laptop, when we have TWO VPS available to you? Almost NOTHING should be running on this laptop, just a single metroplat instance that federates with the rest"; 2026-09-27: "why does metroplat even need a vps instead of just a worker?".

requirements.says: The Group's Bare Cedar Fog resources shall live in one section folder, the Bare Cedar Fog persistent computer machine section, with info/ as the snapshot of the laptop's 561 Group resources.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-08: "HOW DO YOU NOT HAVE ALL OUR BARE CEDAR FOG STUFF IN LIKE ONE FUCKING FOLDER"; the section path 561-group-computer-services-section / 561-group-computer-machine-services-section / 561-group-persistent-computer-machine-services-section / bare-cedar-fog-services-section; "All work on this machine goes under info/".

requirements.says: The Bare Cedar Fog devops documentation shall state how local branches, local changes and the remote are reconciled, how Guix and Guile realize the machine, and how CI and CD run, so that no agent needs to discover them.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-08: local branches to merge and local changes to commit, local and remote to be reconciled; "Guix, Guile; info/ is meant to be the snapshot of this laptop's 561 Group resources … Cold Red Gate is our VPS"; "no agent should ever need to struggle about our devops, CI, CD".

requirements.says: The Group's harness code shall be located in one section, with its roughly one hundred lines no longer split across GitHub, legacy and Cold Red Gate.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-08: "there are like 100 lines of code that are harness split across github and legacy and cold red gate and and and and".

requirements.says: Every name the Group uses for the Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance shall be "Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance", and no agent or document shall call it a node.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06: "anything that is making you and other folk call the Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance a 'Node' … CHANGE THAT; 'Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance' EVERY TIME".

conditions.says: Disk, git, package and command effects of an agent session on Bare Cedar Fog appear in the machine server's records and nowhere else.
The list of systemd units on each machine equals the permitted set.
A search of house records finds no use of "node" for the Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance.
